Enhanced Workout Plan ​

Plan Overview

This 6-day hybrid routine is designed for aggressive fat loss (30% → 17% body fat), muscle building, and sports performance enhancement. Combines strength training, metabolic conditioning, and sport-specific power development.

Table of Contents ​

  • Weekly Schedule
  • Strength Training Days
    • Monday - Upper Body Strength
    • Wednesday - Lower Body Power
    • Friday - Push/Pull Supersets
  • Conditioning Days
    • Tuesday - HIIT + Core
    • Saturday - Full Body Circuit
  • Active Recovery
    • Thursday - Pre-Tennis Prep
    • Sunday - Recovery & Mobility
  • Exercise Guides
  • Progression Guidelines

Nutrition Support

Pair this workout plan with our Fat Loss Meal Plan for optimal results.

Weekly Schedule ​

  • Monday: Upper Body Strength + Metabolic Finisher (45 min)
  • Tuesday: HIIT Cardio + Core + Flexibility (30 min)
  • Wednesday: Lower Body Power + Strength (45 min)
  • Thursday: Pre-Tennis Prep + Tennis (15 min prep)
  • Friday: Push/Pull Supersets + Sports Power (45 min)
  • Saturday: Full Body Circuit + Conditioning (40 min)
  • Sunday: Active Recovery + Deep Flexibility (20 min)

Fat Loss Focus

Training frequency increased to 6 days for accelerated fat loss while building muscle. Higher volume supports your 2,100 calorie deficit and 13% body fat reduction goal.

Strength Training Days ​

Intensity Guidelines

RPE Target: 7-8/10 - You should have 2-3 reps left in the tank. Focus on progressive overload while maintaining perfect form for injury prevention.

Monday - Upper Body Strength + Metabolic Finisher ​

Session Overview - 45 minutes total

Focus: Upper body muscle building + fat-burning finisher Equipment: Compound movements + cables
Benefits: Muscle growth, strength, and metabolic boost

Dynamic Warm-up (8 min)

  • Arm circles and shoulder rolls (2 min)
  • Band pull-aparts (1 min)
  • Cat-cow + thoracic rotations (2 min)
  • Light rowing or arm bike (3 min)

Strength Training (28 min)

  1. Chest Press Machine - 4 sets x 6-8 reps (Start: 35-45kg)
    • Rest: 90 seconds between sets
  2. Lat Pulldown Wide Grip - 4 sets x 8-10 reps (Start: 40-50kg)
    • Rest: 90 seconds between sets
  3. Superset A (3 rounds, 60s rest):
    • Shoulder Press Machine - 10-12 reps (Start: 20-30kg)
    • Seated Cable Row - 12-15 reps (Start: 35-45kg)
  4. Superset B (3 rounds, 45s rest):
    • Cable Face Pulls - 15-20 reps (Start: 15-25kg)
    • Cable Tricep Extension - 12-15 reps (Start: 20-30kg)

Metabolic Finisher (7 min)Upper Body Burnout Circuit - 3 rounds, no rest between exercises:

  • Push-ups (max reps in 45 seconds)
  • Mountain climbers (45 seconds)
  • Plank hold (30 seconds)
  • Rest 60 seconds between rounds

Cool Down (2 min)

  • Doorway chest stretch - 30 seconds each arm
  • Cross-body shoulder stretch - 30 seconds each arm

Wednesday - Lower Body Power + Strength ​

Session Overview - 45 minutes total

Focus: Lower body power + strength for climbing and tennis Equipment: Compound movements + plyometrics Benefits: Explosive power, leg strength, athletic performance

Dynamic Warm-up (8 min)

  • Light walking/jogging (3 min)
  • Leg swings + hip circles (2 min)
  • Walking lunges + butt kicks (2 min)
  • Ankle mobility (1 min)

Power Development (12 min)

  1. Jump Squats - 4 sets x 6-8 explosive reps
    • Rest: 90 seconds between sets
  2. Lateral Bounds - 3 sets x 8 each direction
    • Rest: 60 seconds between sets

Strength Training (20 min)

  1. Leg Press Machine - 4 sets x 8-10 reps (Start: 80-100kg)
    • Rest: 90 seconds between sets
  2. Superset A (3 rounds, 60s rest):
    • Leg Curl Machine - 10-12 reps (Start: 20-30kg)
    • Leg Extension Machine - 12-15 reps (Start: 25-35kg)
  3. Superset B (3 rounds, 45s rest):
    • Seated Calf Raise - 15-20 reps (Start: 25-35kg)
    • Walking Lunges - 20 total steps (bodyweight)

Flexibility (5 min)

  • Standing quad stretch - 45 seconds each leg
  • Hip flexor stretch - 45 seconds each side
  • Standing hamstring stretch - 45 seconds each leg

Friday - Push/Pull Supersets + Sports Power ​

Session Overview - 45 minutes total

Focus: Upper body hypertrophy + rotational power Equipment: Cable machines + functional movements Benefits: Muscle building, tennis serve power, golf swing strength

Dynamic Warm-up (6 min)

  • Arm circles + shoulder rolls (2 min)
  • Band pull-aparts + external rotations (2 min)
  • Torso twists + arm swings (2 min)

Push/Pull Supersets (25 min)Superset 1 (4 rounds, 90s rest):

  • Chest Press Machine - 8-10 reps (Progressive load)
  • Cable Row Wide Grip - 10-12 reps (Progressive load)

Superset 2 (4 rounds, 75s rest):

  • Shoulder Press Machine - 10-12 reps
  • Lat Pulldown Close Grip - 12-15 reps

Superset 3 (3 rounds, 60s rest):

  • Tricep Dip Machine - 12-15 reps
  • Cable Face Pulls - 15-20 reps

Sports Power Block (10 min)

  1. Cable Wood Chops - 3 sets x 8 each side (explosive)
  2. Medicine Ball Slams - 3 sets x 10 (if available, or explosive push-ups)
  3. Rotary Torso Machine - 2 sets x 12 each direction

Cool Down (4 min)

  • Chest + shoulder stretches (2 min)
  • Spinal rotation stretch (2 min)

Conditioning Days ​

Fat Loss Focus

These high-intensity sessions maximize calorie burn and improve cardiovascular fitness for tennis performance while supporting your aggressive fat loss goals.

Tuesday - HIIT Cardio + Core ​

Session Overview - 30 minutes total

Focus: Metabolic conditioning + core strength Equipment: Cardio machines + bodyweight Benefits: Fat burning, tennis endurance, core stability

Warm-up (5 min)

  • Light cardio (treadmill, bike, or rower) - build to moderate intensity

HIIT Cardio Block (15 min)Option 1 - Treadmill Intervals:

  • 3 min moderate walk (3-4% incline)
  • 8 rounds: 30s sprint (6-8% incline) + 90s recovery walk
  • 2 min cool down walk

Option 2 - Bike/Rower Intervals:

  • 3 min moderate pace
  • 8 rounds: 30s all-out + 90s easy pace
  • 2 min cool down

Core Strength Circuit (8 min)3 rounds, 45s work / 15s rest:

  • Dead bugs (alternating)
  • Plank to downward dog
  • Russian twists
  • Bicycle crunches

Flexibility (2 min)

  • Hip flexor stretch - 30s each side
  • Spinal twist - 30s each side

Saturday - Full Body Circuit + Conditioning ​

Session Overview - 40 minutes total

Focus: Full body conditioning + metabolic challenge Equipment: Circuit training + bodyweight Benefits: Fat burning, muscular endurance, functional fitness

Dynamic Warm-up (6 min)

  • Joint mobility sequence (2 min)
  • Bodyweight movement prep (2 min)
  • Light cardio buildup (2 min)

Full Body Strength Circuit (20 min)Circuit A - 4 rounds, 45s work/15s rest, 90s rest between rounds:

  1. Chest Press Machine - moderate weight, 12-15 reps
  2. Leg Press Machine - moderate weight, 15-20 reps
  3. Bodyweight Squats - maximum reps
  4. Seated Cable Row - 12-15 reps
  5. Push-ups - maximum reps (modify as needed)

Metabolic Finisher (10 min)EMOM (Every Minute on the Minute) - 10 rounds:

  • Minute 1: 15 Mountain climbers + 10 Jump squats
  • Minute 2: 10 Burpees (or modified burpees)
  • Use remaining time in each minute to rest

Cool Down (4 min)

  • Full body flow stretches
  • Deep breathing and relaxation

Active Recovery ​

Recovery Importance

Active recovery sessions are crucial for maintaining mobility, preventing injury, and supporting your intensive training schedule while in a caloric deficit.

Thursday - Pre-Tennis Prep ​

Essential Pre-Tennis Routine - 15 minutes

Focus: Dynamic warm-up and tennis-specific preparation Equipment: None required Benefits: Injury prevention and performance optimization

Dynamic Tennis Preparation (15 min)

  1. Wrist Circles & Flexor Stretches - 2 min
  2. Tennis-Specific Arm Swings - 2 min
  3. Shoulder Cross-body & External Rotation - 2 min
  4. Hip Circles & Leg Swings - 2 min
  5. Gentle Spinal Rotation - 2 min
  6. Calf Raises & Ankle Mobility - 2 min
  7. Shadow Tennis Movements - 3 min

Sunday - Recovery & Mobility ​

Weekly Recovery Session - 20 minutes

Focus: Full body flexibility and weekly reset Equipment: None required Benefits: Enhanced recovery and mobility maintenance

Full Body Flow (20 min)

  1. Gentle Sun Salutation Flow - 3 rounds (6 min)
  2. Deep Hip Opening Sequence:
    • Pigeon pose - 2 min each side
    • Seated figure-4 stretch - 1 min each side
  3. Spinal Mobility:
    • Seated spinal twist - 1 min each side
    • Gentle backbend - 1 min
  4. Final Relaxation - 3 min in child's pose or legs up the wall

Progression Guidelines ​

Fat Loss & Body Recomposition Focus ​

Weeks 1-2: Foundation Building

  • Focus on form and movement patterns
  • RPE 6-7/10 (moderate intensity)
  • Complete all prescribed sets and reps
  • Track body weight and measurements

Weeks 3-4: Intensity Increase

  • Increase weights by 10-15% where possible
  • RPE 7-8/10 (challenging but controlled)
  • Add 5-10% more cardio volume if energy allows
  • Monitor strength maintenance while losing fat

Weeks 5-8: Progressive Overload

  • Continue weight increases every 2 weeks
  • Add extra sets to lagging muscle groups
  • Increase metabolic finisher difficulty
  • Assess if additional cardio is needed

Weeks 9-16: Final Push

  • Focus on strength maintenance during deeper deficit
  • Increase conditioning frequency if fat loss stalls
  • Prioritize recovery and flexibility work
  • Prepare for transition to maintenance/building phase

Weight Progression Guidelines ​

Upper Body Machines:

  • Week 1-2: Start weights as listed
  • Week 3-4: Increase by 10-15%
  • Target progression: 2.5-5kg increases every 2-3 weeks

Lower Body Machines:

  • Week 1-2: Start weights as listed
  • Week 3-4: Increase by 15-20%
  • Target progression: 5-10kg increases every 2-3 weeks

Cardio Progression ​

HIIT Sessions:

  • Week 1-2: Complete as prescribed
  • Week 3-4: Increase sprint intervals by 15 seconds
  • Week 5+: Add extra round or increase incline/resistance

Health & Safety ​

Important Safety Guidelines

Read this section carefully before starting this intensive routine.

Managing Higher Training Volume ​

Pre-Workout Preparation:

  • Eat 200-300 calories 1-2 hours before training
  • Consume 500-600ml water 30-60 minutes before
  • Ensure adequate sleep (7-9 hours) for recovery

During Workouts:

  • Sip water between exercises, don't chug
  • Take prescribed rest periods seriously
  • Monitor heart rate during HIIT (stay below 85% max)
  • Stop immediately if experiencing dizziness or nausea

Recovery Between Sessions:

  • Prioritize protein intake within 2 hours post-workout
  • Aim for 140g protein daily to preserve muscle
  • Get quality sleep - crucial during deficit
  • Listen to your body - take extra rest days if needed

Red Flags - Reduce Volume or Take Rest Day:

  • Persistent fatigue lasting >2 days
  • Declining strength for 2+ consecutive sessions
  • Sleep disruption or increased stress
  • Joint pain or unusual muscle soreness
  • Extreme hunger or food preoccupation
